[NDBG.14.11.1] Returns the complete pattern-and-join match chain
that produced a given firing — the activation-path view per
LDEB.3.3.4. Answers "exactly which facts matched each LHS pattern?"

Request: `{ "firing": "!47" }`, or `{ "threadId": 9 }`

Response:
```json
{
  "rule_name": "pair_check",
  "display_name": "pair_check(s=kitchen_temp, e=kitchen_temp)",
  "steps": [
    { "pattern_index": 0,
      "schema": "Sensor",
      "binding": "s",
      "fact_id": "#42",
      "slots": { "entity_id": "kitchen_temp", "value": 95.2 },
      "join_result": "passed",
      "join_detail": "alpha filter passed (no where on this pattern)" },
    { "pattern_index": 1,
      "schema": "Event",
      "binding": "e",
      "fact_id": "#77",
      "slots": { "entity_id": "kitchen_temp", "payload": "{}" },
      "join_result": "passed",
      "join_detail": "join e.entity_id == s.entity_id: both 'kitchen_temp'" }
  ]
}
```
